title: fix(tools): route OpenAPITool parameters by their location

             raise ToolError(f"Path must be a relative path, not a URL: {path}")
 
-        resolved = urljoin(base_url, path)
+        # The operation path is appended to the server URL (as OpenAPI defines it), so the

         base_parsed = urlparse(base_url)

@@ -103,6 +107,37 @@ def _validate_path_safe(base_url: str | None, path: str) -> str:
 
         return resolved
 
+    @staticmethod
+    def _serialize_value(value: Any) -> str:
+        # Python's str(True) is "True"; OpenAPI (and JSON) booleans are lowercase.
+        if isinstance(value, bool):
+            return "true" if value else "false"
+        if isinstance(value, list):
+            # OpenAPI's default "simple" style for path, header and cookie arrays.
+            return ",".join(OpenAPITool._serialize_value(item) for item in value)
+        return str(value)
+
+    def _parameter_locations(self, path: str, method: str) -> dict[str, str]:
+        """Map each parameter name of the operation to its `in` location (path, query, header or cookie)."""
+        path_spec = self.open_api_schema.get("paths", {}).get(path) or {}
+        method_spec = path_spec.get(method) or path_spec.get(method.lower()) or {}
+
+        def resolve(parameter: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+            if isinstance(parameter, dict) and "$ref" in parameter:
+                resolved: Any = self.open_api_schema
+                for segment in parameter["$ref"].split("/"):
+                    if segment != "#":
+                        resolved = resolved.get(segment) if isinstance(resolved, dict) else None
+                return resolved if isinstance(resolved, dict) else {}
+            return parameter if isinstance(parameter, dict) else {}
+
+        locations: dict[str, str] = {}
+        for parameter in [*path_spec.get("parameters", []), *method_spec.get("parameters", [])]:
+            resolved_parameter = resolve(parameter)
+            if "name" in resolved_parameter:
+                locations[resolved_parameter["name"]] = resolved_parameter.get("in", "query")
+        return locations
+
     def _create_emitter(self) -> Emitter:
         return Emitter.root().child(
             namespace=["tool", "web", "openAPI", to_safe_word(self._name)],
@@ -243,29 +278,71 @@ async def _run(
 
         raw_path = input_dict.get("path", self.path) or ""
         method = input_dict.get("method", self.method) or ""
-        resolved_url = self._validate_path_safe(self.url, raw_path)
+
+        locations = self._parameter_locations(raw_path, method)
+        # An unset optional parameter dumps as None; leave it out instead of sending "None".
+        parameters = {k: v for k, v in (input_dict.get("parameters") or {}).items() if v is not None}
+        query_params: dict[str, Any] = {}
+        request_headers: dict[str, str] = {}
+        cookies: list[str] = []
+        path = raw_path
+        for name, value in parameters.items():
+            # A parameter the spec does not describe goes to the path if it has a `{name}` slot, else to the query.
+            location = locations.get(name) or ("path" if f"{{{name}}}" in raw_path else "query")
+            if location == "path":
+                serialized = self._serialize_value(value)
+                # Dot segments would be normalized away and step outside the server's base path.
+                if serialized in (".", ".."):
+                    raise ToolError(f"Invalid value for path parameter '{name}': {serialized}")
+                path = path.replace(f"{{{name}}}", quote(serialized, safe=""))
+            elif location == "header":
+                # OpenAPI ignores header parameters with these names; they come from the tool's configuration.
+                if name.lower() in ("accept", "content-type", "authorization"):
+                    continue
+                serialized = self._serialize_value(value)
+                if any(ord(char) < 32 or ord(char) == 127 for char in serialized):
+                    raise ToolError(f"Invalid value for header parameter '{name}'.")
+                request_headers[name] = serialized
+            elif location == "cookie":
+                cookies.append(f"{name}={quote(self._serialize_value(value), safe='')}")
+            else:
+                values = value if isinstance(value, list) else [value]
+                query_params[name] = [self._serialize_value(v) for v in values]
+
+        resolved_url = self._validate_path_safe(self.url, path)
 
         # pyrefly: ignore [bad-specialization]
         parsed_url = urlparse(resolved_url)
         # pyrefly: ignore [bad-argument-type]
         search_params = parse_qs(parsed_url.query)
-        # An unset optional parameter dumps as None; leave it out instead of sending "None".
-        search_params.update({k: v for k, v in (input_dict.get("parameters") or {}).items() if v is not None})
+        search_params.update(query_params)
         new_params = urlencode(search_params, doseq=True)
         url = urlunparse(parsed_url._replace(query=new_params))
 
         body = input_dict.get("body")
         # The input schema prefers an application/json request body, so send it as JSON, not form-encoded.
-        request_body = self.open_api_schema.get("paths", {}).get(raw_path, {}).get(method, {}).get("requestBody", {})
+        path_spec = self.open_api_schema.get("paths", {}).get(raw_path, {})
+        request_body = (path_spec.get(method) or path_spec.get(method.lower()) or {}).get("requestBody", {})
         send_json = "application/json" in request_body.get("content", {})
 
+        # Configured headers win over the model's header parameters, compared case-insensitively.
+        configured = {name.lower() for name in self.headers}
+        headers = {
+            "Accept": "application/json",
+            **{name: value for name, value in request_headers.items() if name.lower() not in configured},
+            **self.headers,
+        }
+        if cookies:
+            existing = next((k for k in headers if k.lower() == "cookie"), None)
+            headers[existing or "Cookie"] = "; ".join(([headers[existing]] if existing else []) + cookies)
+
         await self.emitter.emit("before_fetch", BeforeFetchEvent(url=str(url), input=input_dict))
         try:
             async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
                 response = await client.request(
                     method=method,
                     url=str(url),
-                    headers={"Accept": "application/json", **self.headers},
+                    headers=headers,
                     json=body if send_json else None,
                     data=None if send_json else body,
                 )

@@ -8,6 +8,7 @@
 import httpx
 import pytest
 
+from beeai_framework.tools import ToolError
 from beeai_framework.tools.openapi import OpenAPITool
 
 YAML_SPEC = """
@@ -154,3 +155,199 @@ async def fake_send(self: httpx.AsyncClient, request: httpx.Request, **kwargs: o
         assert json.loads(request.content) == expected_body
     else:
         assert parse_qs(request.content.decode()) == expected_body
+
+
+def _schema(server_url: str, path: str, method_spec: dict) -> dict:
+    return {
+        "openapi": "3.0.0",
+        "info": {"title": "Pets", "version": "1.0"},
+        "servers": [{"url": server_url}],
+        "paths": {path: {"get": {"operationId": "op", "responses": {"200": {"description": "ok"}}, **method_spec}}},
+    }
+
+
+async def _run_and_capture(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, schema: dict, parameters: dict, headers: dict[str, str] | None = None
+) -> tuple[str, dict[str, str]]:
+    captured: dict[str, object] = {}
+
+    async def fake_request(self: httpx.AsyncClient, method: str, url: str, **kwargs: object) -> httpx.Response:
+        captured["url"] = url
+        captured["headers"] = kwargs["headers"]
+        return httpx.Response(200, text="{}")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(httpx.AsyncClient, "request", fake_request)
+
+    [tool] = OpenAPITool.from_schema(schema)
+    tool.headers = headers or {}
+    await tool.run({"parameters": parameters})
+    return str(captured["url"]), dict(captured["headers"])  # type: ignore[call-overload]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.unit
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_path_parameters_are_substituted_not_sent_as_query(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
+    schema = _schema(
+        "https://example.invalid",
+        "/pets/{petId}",
+        {"parameters": [{"name": "petId", "in": "path", "required": True, "schema": {"type": "string"}}]},
+    )
+
+    url, _ = await _run_and_capture(monkeypatch, schema, {"petId": "a/b c"})
+
+    assert url == "https://example.invalid/pets/a%2Fb%20c"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.unit
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_header_and_cookie_parameters_are_sent_as_headers(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
+    schema = _schema(
+        "https://example.invalid",
+        "/pets",
+        {
+            "parameters": [
+                {"name": "limit", "in": "query", "schema": {"type": "integer"}},
+                {"name": "X-Request-Id", "in": "header", "schema": {"type": "string"}},
+                {"name": "session", "in": "cookie", "schema": {"type": "string"}},
+                {"name": "theme", "in": "cookie", "schema": {"type": "string"}},
+            ]
+        },
+    )
+
+    url, headers = await _run_and_capture(
+        monkeypatch, schema, {"limit": 5, "X-Request-Id": "abc", "session": "s1", "theme": "dark"}
+    )
+
+    assert url == "https://example.invalid/pets?limit=5"
+    assert headers["X-Request-Id"] == "abc"
+    assert headers["Cookie"] == "session=s1; theme=dark"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.unit
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_boolean_query_parameters_are_lowercase(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
+    schema = _schema(
+        "https://example.invalid",
+        "/pets",
+        {"parameters": [{"name": "flag", "in": "query", "schema": {"type": "boolean"}}]},
+    )
+
+    url, _ = await _run_and_capture(monkeypatch, schema, {"flag": False})
+
+    assert url == "https://example.invalid/pets?flag=false"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.unit
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_server_url_path_and_query_are_kept(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
+    schema = _schema(
+        "https://example.invalid/api?key=k",
+        "/pets/{petId}",
+        {
+            "parameters": [
+                {"name": "petId", "in": "path", "required": True, "schema": {"type": "integer"}},
+                {"name": "verbose", "in": "query", "schema": {"type": "boolean"}},
+            ]
+        },
+    )
+
+    url, _ = await _run_and_capture(monkeypatch, schema, {"petId": 1, "verbose": True})
+
+    assert url == "https://example.invalid/api/pets/1?key=k&verbose=true"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.unit
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("value", [".", ".."])
+async def test_dot_segment_path_parameters_are_rejected(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, value: str) -> None:
+    schema = _schema(
+        "https://example.invalid/v1",
+        "/pets/{petId}",
+        {"parameters": [{"name": "petId", "in": "path", "required": True, "schema": {"type": "string"}}]},
+    )
+
+    # httpx would normalize "/v1/pets/.." to "/v1", outside the operation's path.
+    with pytest.raises(ToolError):
+        await _run_and_capture(monkeypatch, schema, {"petId": value})
+
+
+@pytest.mark.unit
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_configured_headers_win_over_header_parameters(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
+    schema = _schema(
+        "https://example.invalid",
+        "/pets",
+        {
+            "parameters": [
+                {"name": "Authorization", "in": "header", "schema": {"type": "string"}},
+                {"name": "x-tenant", "in": "header", "schema": {"type": "string"}},
+                {"name": "X-Trace", "in": "header", "schema": {"type": "string"}},
+            ]
+        },
+    )
+
+    _, headers = await _run_and_capture(
+        monkeypatch,
+        schema,
+        {"Authorization": "Bearer attacker", "x-tenant": "other", "X-Trace": "t1"},
+        headers={"Authorization": "Bearer secret", "X-Tenant": "mine"},
+    )
+
+    assert headers == {
+        "Accept": "application/json",
+        "X-Trace": "t1",
+        "Authorization": "Bearer secret",
+        "X-Tenant": "mine",
+    }
+
+
+@pytest.mark.unit
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_header_parameter_with_line_break_is_rejected(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
+    schema = _schema(
+        "https://example.invalid",
+        "/pets",
+        {"parameters": [{"name": "X-Request-Id", "in": "header", "schema": {"type": "string"}}]},
+    )
+
+    with pytest.raises(ToolError):
+        await _run_and_capture(monkeypatch, schema, {"X-Request-Id": "a\r\nX-Evil: 1"})
+
+
+@pytest.mark.unit
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_cookie_values_are_encoded(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
+    schema = _schema(
+        "https://example.invalid",
+        "/pets",
+        {"parameters": [{"name": "session", "in": "cookie", "schema": {"type": "string"}}]},
+    )
+
+    _, headers = await _run_and_capture(monkeypatch, schema, {"session": "s1; admin=true"})
+
+    assert headers["Cookie"] == "session=s1%3B%20admin%3Dtrue"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.unit
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_array_path_and_header_parameters_use_simple_style(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
+    schema = _schema(
+        "https://example.invalid",
+        "/pets/{ids}",
+        {
+            "parameters": [
+                {
+                    "name": "ids",
+                    "in": "path",
+                    "required": True,
+                    "schema": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "integer"}},
+                },
+                {"name": "X-Tags", "in": "header", "schema": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}}},
+            ]
+        },
+    )
+
+    url, headers = await _run_and_capture(monkeypatch, schema, {"ids": [1, 2], "X-Tags": ["a", "b"]})
+
+    assert url == "https://example.invalid/pets/1%2C2"
+    assert headers["X-Tags"] == "a,b"
